english.heading: Small Livestock Integration
body: Small livestock integration turns chickens, ducks, and bees into working parts of the farm.
Learn how animals can control pests, build fertility, support pollination, and return value to the soil.
Use the system you already have: food, manure, flowers, grazing, and careful movement across the land.

body.text: Ukudibanisa imfuyo emincinci kwenza iinkukhu, iidada neenyosi zibe ngamalungu asebenzayo efama.
Funda indlela izilwanyana ezinokulawula ngayo izinambuzane, zakhe ukutyeba komhlaba, zixhase ukungenisa umgubo, zibuyisele ixabiso emhlabeni.
Sebenzisa inkqubo esele unayo: ukutya, ubulongwe, iintyatyambo, ukulisa nokushukuma ngocoselelo kuwo wonke umhlaba.

english.heading: Why This Matters
body: Small livestock can do work beyond producing meat, eggs, or honey.
Chickens eat some insects and weed seeds. Their manure can become compost.
Ducks scratch less than chickens, but can still damage plants.
Bees and other pollinators help many crops. Each animal still needs suitable food, water, shelter and care.

body.text: Imfuyo encinci inokwenza umsebenzi ngaphezu kokuvelisa inyama, amaqanda okanye ubusi.
Iinkukhu zitya ezinye izinambuzane nembewu yokhula. Ubulongwe bazo bunokuba ngumgquba.
Iidada zikrwela kancinci kunenkukhu, kodwa zisenokonakalisa izityalo.
Iinyosi nezinye izinambuzane ezisasaza umgubo zinceda izityalo ezininzi. Isilwanyana ngasinye sisadinga ukutya okufanelekileyo, amanzi, indawo yokukhosela nokukhathalelwa.

english.heading: Learning Outcomes
body: By the end of this module, you will understand how chickens, ducks, bees, and guinea fowl fit into a working system.
You will know when chickens help a bed, and when their scratching can cause damage.
You will understand pollination, hive placement, and how livestock move nutrients around a farm.

body.text: Ekupheleni kwesi sifundo, uya kuqonda indlela iinkukhu, iidada, iinyosi ne-guinea fowl ezingena ngayo kwinkqubo esebenzayo.
Uya kwazi ukuba iinkukhu zinceda ibhedi nini, nokuba ukukrwela kwazo kunokonakalisa nini.
Uya kuqonda ukungenisa umgubo, indawo yokubeka umzi wenyosi, nendlela imfuyo ehambisa ngayo izondlo kwifama.

english.heading: Watch: Hens Foraging After Harvest
body: Watch the hens peck at the ground among dry plant remains.
Chickens may eat some insects and weed seeds. They still need balanced feed, clean water and shelter.
Keep them away from seedlings and food ready to harvest.

heading.text: Bukela: iinkukhu zifuna ukutya emva kokuvuna

body.text: Bukela iinkukhu zifuna ukutya emhlabeni phakathi kwentsalela yezityalo ezomileyo.
Iinkukhu zisenokutya ezinye izinambuzane nembewu yokhula. Zisadinga ukutya okunesondlo ngokufanelekileyo, amanzi acocekileyo nendawo yokukhosela.
Zigcine kude nezithombo nokutya okulungele ukuvunwa.

english.heading: Chickens Turn Scratching Into Useful Work
body: Chickens can help an empty bed after harvest.
They scratch through plant remains and eat some insects and weed seeds.
Their manure and bedding can be composted and returned to the soil.
Foraging does not replace a balanced diet, clean water, shelter or daily care.

heading.text: Iinkukhu zijika ukukrwela kube ngumsebenzi oluncedo

body.text: Iinkukhu zinokunceda kwibhedi engenanto emva kokuvuna.
Zikrwela phakathi kwentsalela yezityalo zize zitye ezinye izinambuzane nembewu yokhula.
Ubulongwe bazo nezinto zokulala zazo zinokwenziwa umgquba zibuyiselwe emhlabeni.
Ukuzifunela ukutya akuyithatheli indawo ukutya okunesondlo ngokufanelekileyo, amanzi acocekileyo, indawo yokukhosela nokukhathalelwa yonke imihla.

english.heading: Use Chickens at the Right Time
body: Use chickens in an empty bed after harvest.
Keep them away from seedlings and crops being harvested for food.
Fresh manure can carry germs. Ask an extension adviser how to manage manure safely before the next crop.
Move the birds before they damage the ground.

body.text: Sebenzisa iinkukhu kwibhedi engenanto emva kokuvuna.
Zigcine kude nezithombo nezityalo ezivunelwa ukutya.
Ubulongwe obutsha bunokuba neentsholongwane. Cela umcebisi wezolimo akuxelele indlela yokujongana nobulongwe ngokukhuselekileyo phambi kwesityalo esilandelayo.
Zishukumise iintaka phambi kokuba zonakalise umhlaba.

english.heading: Ducks Suit Established Understorey
body: Ducks eat slugs and snails without the heavy scratching of chickens.
They may suit an established food forest understorey.
They can still eat or trample plants and make wet ground muddy. Watch the birds and move them when needed.
Provide clean water and suitable feed; foraging alone may not be enough.

body.text: Iidada zitya ii-slug nee-snail ngaphandle kokukrwela okunamandla kweenkukhu.
Zisenokufanela umgangatho ongezantsi wehlathi lokutya elimileyo.
Zisenokutya okanye zinyathele izityalo zenze umhlaba omanzi ube yodaka. Bukela iintaka uzishukumise xa kuyimfuneko.
Nika amanzi acocekileyo nokutya okufanelekileyo; ukuzifunela kodwa kusenokunganeli.

english.heading: Rotate the Tractor Across the Plot
body: A chicken tractor is a moveable, floorless pen.
Move it before the ground becomes bare, muddy or heavily covered with manure.
The right time depends on the birds, soil and weather. Let the ground recover between visits.
There is no single number of chickens that guarantees enough fertility for every plot.

body.text: I-chicken tractor yikhola eshukumayo, engenaphantsi.
Yishukumise phambi kokuba umhlaba ungabi nasityalo, ube yodaka okanye ugutyungelwe kakhulu bubulongwe.
Ixesha elifanelekileyo lixhomekeke kwiintaka, kumhlaba nakwimozulu. Vumela umhlaba uphole phakathi kotyelelo.
Akukho nani linye leenkukhu eliqinisekisa ukuba kuya kubakho ukutyeba komhlaba okwaneleyo kuyo yonke isiza.

english.heading: Watch: A Bee Moves Between Two Blossoms
body: Watch one bee move from one blossom to another.
Bees can carry pollen as they visit flowers.

heading.text: Bukela: inyosi ihamba phakathi kweentyatyambo ezimbini

body.text: Bukela inyosi enye ihamba isuka kwintyatyambo enye iye kwenye.
Iinyosi zinokuthwala umgubo njengoko zityelela iintyatyambo.

english.heading: Bees Help Pollinate Many Crops
body: Honeybees and other insects carry pollen between flowers.
This helps many fruit and vegetable crops, including avocado. Different crops and varieties have different pollination needs.
A hive does not guarantee higher yields everywhere. Weather, water, plant health and other pollinators also matter.

heading.text: Iinyosi zinceda ukungenisa umgubo kwizityalo ezininzi

body.text: Iinyosi zobusi nezinye izinambuzane zithwala umgubo phakathi kweentyatyambo.
Oku kunceda izityalo ezininzi zeziqhamo nemifuno, kuquka i-avocado. Izityalo neentlobo ezahlukeneyo ziyahluka ngezinto ezizidingayo ekungeniseni umgubo.
Umzi wenyosi awuqinisekisi isivuno esingcono kuyo yonke indawo. Imozulu, amanzi, impilo yezityalo nezinye izinambuzane ezisasaza umgubo nazo ziyabalulekile.

english.heading: South Africa’s Native Honeybees
body: South Africa has two native honeybee subspecies.
The Cape honeybee is found in the Western Cape and parts of the Eastern Cape. The African honeybee is native to central and most of southern Africa.
These broad natural ranges are not a guide for moving bees. The Department's control measures set a demarcation line for bee movement. Check current rules before moving bees or hives.

body.text: UMzantsi Afrika uneentlobo ezincinci ezimbini zeenyosi zobusi zemveli.

Inyosi yobusi yaseKapa (Cape honeybee) ifumaneka eNtshona Koloni nakwezinye iindawo zeMpuma Koloni. Inyosi yobusi yase-Afrika (African honeybee) yeyemveli kwi-Afrika ephakathi nakubuninzi boMzantsi weAfrika.

Ezi ndawo zendalo ezibanzi aziyondlela yokukhokela ekuhambiseni iinyosi. Amanyathelo okulawula eSebe amisela umgca wokwahlula olawula ukuhanjiswa kweenyosi. Jonga imithetho yangoku phambi kokuhambisa iinyosi okanye imizi yeenyosi.

english.heading: Place the Hive With Care
body: Learn from an experienced local beekeeper before getting a hive.
Keep hives away from busy paths, homes and places where children play.
Morning sun can help, but a safe location comes first.
Plan how people and animals will move around the site.

body.text: Funda kumgcini weenyosi onamava wasekuhlaleni phambi kokufumana umzi wenyosi.
Gcina imizi yeenyosi kude neendlela ezixineneyo, amakhaya neendawo apho abantwana badlala khona.
Ilanga lasekuseni linokunceda, kodwa indawo ekhuselekileyo ibalulekile kuqala.
Cwangcisa indlela abantu nezilwanyana abaya kuhamba ngayo ejikeleze indawo.

english.heading: Strong Colonies Need Care and Flowers
body: Provide flowering plants through the seasons and avoid exposing bees to pesticides.
Active bees do not prove that the farm is free of chemicals or disease.

Registration is required for activities defined by the national honey-bee control measures. These include keeping managed hives for bee products, queen rearing, commercial pollination, and removing, eradicating or relocating colonies. Check with the Department if you are unsure whether your activity is covered.
If a colony swarms repeatedly, ask a trained beekeeper to inspect it. Crowding is one possible cause, not a diagnosis.

heading.text: Amaqela eenyosi aqinileyo adinga ukukhathalelwa neentyatyambo

body.text: Nika izityalo ezinentyatyambo ngamaxesha onke onyaka kwaye uphephe ukuveza iinyosi kumachiza okubulala izinambuzane.
Iinyosi ezisebenzayo aziyongqina lokuba ifama ayinamachiza okanye izifo.

Ukubhaliswa kufuneka kwimisebenzi echazwe ngamanyathelo kazwelonke okulawula iinyosi zobusi. Oku kuquka ukugcina imizi yeenyosi elawulwayo yeemveliso zeenyosi, ukukhulisa ookumkanikazi, ukungenisa umgubo ngokurhweba, nokususa, ukutshatyalalisa okanye ukuhambisa amaqela eenyosi. Buza kwiSebe ukuba awuqinisekanga ukuba umsebenzi wakho ugutyungelwe na.
Ukuba iqela leenyosi liphuma ngamaqela ngokuphindaphindiweyo, cela umgcini weenyosi oqeqeshiweyo alihlole. Ukuxinana sesinye sezizathu ezinokubakho, akukuko ukuxilongwa kwengxaki.

english.heading: Nutrients Moving Through the Farm
body: Some nutrients move from plants to animals. Bought feed also brings nutrients into the farm. Some nutrients may return to the growing area through compost made from manure. Food and other products carry nutrients away.

body.text: Ezinye izondlo ziyahamba ziphume ezityalweni ziye kwizilwanyana. Ukutya okuthengiweyo nako kungenisa izondlo kwifama. Ezinye izondlo zisenokubuyela kwindawo yokutyala ngomgquba owenziwe ngobulongwe. Ukutya nezinye iimveliso kuzisusa izondlo.

english.heading: Some Nutrients Return; Others Enter and Leave
body: Animals can return some nutrients through compost made from manure. Fresh manure can carry harmful germs. Compost manure fully before using it around food crops.
Chickens eat suitable farm produce and insects.
Bought feed brings nutrients into the farm. Food sold or taken home and other products carry nutrients away. Keep track of feed bought in and food sold or taken home.
Scraps alone may not meet the animals’ needs.

heading.text: Ezinye izondlo ziyabuya; ezinye ziyangena ziphume

body.text: Izilwanyana zinokubuyisela ezinye izondlo ngomgquba owenziwe ngobulongwe. Ubulongwe obutsha bunokuba neentsholongwane eziyingozi. Yenza umgquba ngobulongwe ngokupheleleyo ngaphambi kokuba usebenzise kufuphi nezityalo zokutya.
Iinkukhu zitya imveliso efanelekileyo yefama nezinambuzane.

Ukutya okuthengiweyo kungenisa izondlo kwifama. Ukutya okuthengisiweyo okanye okuthathelwe ekhaya nezinye iimveliso kuzisusa izondlo. Gcina irekhodi yokutya okuthengiweyo nokutya okuthengisiweyo okanye okuthathelwe ekhaya.
Intsalela yokutya yodwa isenokunganeli iimfuno zezilwanyana.

english.heading: Guinea Fowl Forage, but Health Checks Still Matter
body: Guinea fowl forage for insects and may eat ticks.
Do not rely on them to protect people or livestock from ticks or tick-borne disease.
Keep checking animals and follow a local animal-health plan.
Foraging birds are one part of the farm, not a replacement for health care.

heading.text: I-guinea fowl ziyazifunela, kodwa uhlolo lwempilo lusabalulekile

body.text: I-guinea fowl zifuna izinambuzane kwaye zisenokutya ii-tick.
Musa ukuzithemba ukukhusela abantu okanye imfuyo kwii-tick okanye kwizifo ezithwalwa zii-tick.
Qhubeka uhlola izilwanyana kwaye ulandele isicwangciso sasekuhlaleni sempilo yezilwanyana.
Iintaka ezizifunelayo zinxalenye yefama, azithathi ndawo yokukhathalelwa kwempilo.

english.heading: Ask Three Questions for Every Animal
body: For each animal, ask what it can eat here.
Ask what useful things it produces.
Then ask what else it needs. Include water, suitable feed, shelter, fencing and daily care.
Some needs may require bought inputs. Plan for them before bringing animals onto the land.

body.text: Kwisilwanyana ngasinye, buza ukuba sinokutya ntoni apha.
Buza ukuba zeziphi izinto eziluncedo esizivelisayo.
Emva koko buza ukuba sidinga ntoni enye. Dibanisa amanzi, ukutya okufanelekileyo, indawo yokukhosela, uthango nokukhathalelwa yonke imihla.
Ezinye iimfuno zisenokufuna izinto ezithengiweyo. Zicwangcise phambi kokungenisa izilwanyana emhlabeni.

english.heading: Grazing and Goat Worm Control
body: Chickens following goats are not a proven replacement for goat worm control.
Grazing management can help, but goats still need health checks.
Work with a veterinary or animal-health adviser on a parasite plan for your herd.
Do not stop treatment because chickens have visited the grazing camp.

body.text: Iinkukhu ezilandela iibhokhwe azizondlela eqinisekisiweyo yokuthatha indawo yolawulo lweentshulube zeebhokhwe.
Ulawulo lokulisa lunokunceda, kodwa iibhokhwe zisafuna uhlolo lwempilo.
Sebenza nogqirha wezilwanyana okanye umcebisi wempilo yezilwanyana kwisicwangciso se-parasite somhlambi wakho.
Musa ukuyeka unyango ngenxa yokuba iinkukhu zityelele inkampu yokulisa.

english.heading: Field Assignment: Draw Where Resources Go
body: Walk your smallholding and choose an area where livestock could support another part of the system.
Record what food, scraps, pests, surplus produce, manure, or flowering resources are already present.
Then note what each animal could produce, and what it would need from the farm.
Draw one useful link between livestock and the rest of your farm. Show what comes in and what leaves.

heading.text: Umsebenzi wasentsimini: zoba apho izixhobo zihamba khona

body.text: Hamba kwifama yakho encinci ukhethe indawo apho imfuyo inokuxhasa enye inxalenye yenkqubo.
Bhala phantsi ukutya, intsalela yokutya, izinambuzane, imveliso eseleyo, ubulongwe okanye izixhobo ezinentyatyambo esele zikho.
Emva koko phawula oko isilwanyana ngasinye sinokukuvelisa, nokuba siya kufuna ntoni kwifama.
Zoba ulwalamano olunye oluluncedo phakathi kwemfuyo nenye inxalenye yefama yakho. Bonisa oko kungena nokuphuma.

english.heading: Field Action: Put One Link to Work
body: Choose one safe action from this module.
Plan how chickens could use an empty bed after harvest, ask a beekeeper about a safe hive position, or check your animals’ daily needs.
Record the food, water, shelter and care that the action requires.
Start with the resources and help you can reliably provide.

body.text: Khetha isenzo esinye esikhuselekileyo kwesi sifundo.

Cwangcisa indlela iinkukhu ezinokusebenzisa ngayo ibhedi engenanto emva kokuvuna, buza umgcini weenyosi ngendawo ekhuselekileyo yomzi wenyosi, okanye hlola iimfuno zemihla ngemihla zezilwanyana zakho.
Bhala phantsi ukutya, amanzi, indawo yokukhosela nokukhathalelwa okufunwa sesi senzo.
Qala ngezixhobo noncedo ozinokubonelela ngazo ngokuthembekileyo.
